target_customer: Medical practices and health systems that want to run an AI clinic for chronic condition patients
problem: Overburdened clinics cannot support chronic patients between visits. Asha lets practices launch an AI clinic with AI agents and AI assisted staff that fills care gaps and adds revenue.
business_model: Subscription for medical practices, with revenue from added care services

founders.name: Akkshay Khoslaa
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led generative AI products at Google and founded a community of 250+ healthcare innovators.

founders.name: Gokul Kumarresen
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led growth engineering at Brex and built secure data transfer tools at Salesforce.

technical_complexity.rationale: Coordinating AI agents and staff for clinical follow up requires EHR integration and safety controls, standard engineering with regulated domain hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Practice workflows and integrations add friction, but healthcare AI agent vendors are numerous.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Search results on these vendors were from 2026 and undated for 2024. No acquisition of Asha found.

market_need_then: The YC page describes chronic condition patients with care gaps that brick and mortar clinics are too overburdened to address.

identity.visual_style: Sparse homepage with a gated full site requiring an emailed access code
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, minimal; 'The AI OS for Healthcare'

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand evidence; the name is shared with an unrelated Seattle company called Asha AI.

outcome_analysis: Asha Health is active with nine people listed and a gated website, so product details are limited. Aggregators report a seed of roughly 3.9 million to 4.4 million USD around December 2024 and January 2025, but none of this is confirmed by a primary source. No acquisition, shutdown or pivot was found.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked says 3.9M USD seed, PitchBook says 3M USD on 2024-12-13, other sites say about 4.4M USD total with General Catalyst and 186 Ventures, another says 500K USD with O'Shaughnessy Ventures; all aggregator or conflicting, so no round is recorded. Competitor search returned only 2026 articles, so the list is empty. Asha AI of Seattle is a different company. Founder technical flags unknown for the CEO.
